scope: Re-enveloped upstream CPUID register dumps for deterministic topology/cache/type tests. Transport, affinity and restore flags are synthetic. XCR0/OS SIMD usability and wtop native AMD host operation are not measured.
upstream_sources: sources.json records pinned original archives/XML SHA-256 and URLs; additional-primary-sources.json records register references, which are not redistributed as implementation code.
transformation: Input mask1: leaf only; mask5: leaf+ECX. Retain bounded native-capture register families, little-endian v2 framing and FNV-1a. Expected CPU memberships, sizes and line widths independently extracted from upstream XML, including L1iCache.
regeneration: python3 tests/fixtures/cpuid/amd/generate.py --source-dir PATH (pinned original tar.bz2 and XML files from sources.json)
